===============GAME INFO=============

Imagine that Rogal Dorn had fallen to heresy and The Salamanders instead were the ones to defend terra.  I don't know if the defenders would have been better off, but we can be sure that it would have been hotter!  Space Marine Steve defends his title as Nick says,  "oooh, space marines seem fun..."
